alerts.title: Alerts
alerts.label: Note (jaise Part 1 of 3)
alerts.telegramNo: Telegram abhi juda nahi — alerts phone pe nahi aayenge
alerts.localNote: Is version mein alerts tab check hote hain jab app khuli ho (har 5 minute). App band ho toh Telegram alert nahi aayega — din mein 2-3 baar app khol lena.
alerts.summaryNote: Roz 3:35 PM ko din ka summary Telegram pe aayega.

tg.s1: Telegram kholo → search mein "BotFather" likho (blue tick wala) → "Start" dabao → /newbot bhejo → naam do (jaise Guri Trade Saathi) → username do jo "bot" pe khatam ho.
tg.s2: BotFather ek lamba token dega jaise 123456789:ABC-xyz… Use lamba dabake copy karo aur neeche paste karo.
tg.s3: BotFather ke message mein aapke bot ka link (t.me/…) hoga. Use kholo aur "Start" dabao. Ghar ke jis member ko bhi alert chahiye, woh bhi yahi kare.
tg.s4: Neeche button dabao — jinhone Start dabaya unke naam dikhenge. Sab pe tick karo aur save karo.
tg.none: Koi chat nahi mila. Bot kholkar "Start" dabao ya "hi" bhejo, phir dobara try karo.
tg.testOk: Message chala gaya! Telegram check karo ✓

settings.title: Settings
settings.dangerDefault: Naye stock ka khatre ka level (abhi ke price se % neeche)
settings.aboutText: Trade Saathi ek personal tool hai. Ye koi investment advice nahi hai, na hi SEBI registered advisor. Ye kabhi order nahi lagata aur broker login nahi maangta. Prices Yahoo Finance se aate hain aur late ho sakte hain. Faisla hamesha aapka.
settings.localData: 📱 Aapka saara data sirf is phone mein save hai (kisi server pe nahi). Hafte mein ek baar "Sara data download karo" se backup le lo.

install.title: Trade Saathi ko Home Screen pe lagao
install.s1: Safari mein neeche Share button (⬆️ wala dabba) dabao
install.s2: Neeche scroll karke "Add to Home Screen" dabao
install.s3: Upar-right "Add" dabao. Ab ye app jaisa khulega!

trigger.d: Woh price jahan pahunchte hi aapka order 'jaag' jata hai. Tab tak order sota rehta hai.
trigger.e: Trigger ₹1,850: price 1,850 tak gira tabhi order chalu hoga.

limit.d: Isse kharab price par order nahi hoga. Bechne mein: isse kam par nahi bikega.
limit.e: Limit ₹1,845: ₹1,845 ya upar hi bikega, neeche nahi.

stoploss.d: Pehle se laga hua 'bachao' order. Price ek hadd se neeche gaya toh apne aap bech deta hai, taaki nuksaan chhota rahe.
stoploss.e: ₹1,900 ka share, SL ₹1,850: gira toh ~₹50 nuksaan pe nikal jaogi.

delivery.d: Delivery (CNC) = share aapke demat mein aata hai, jab tak chaho rakho. Intraday = usi din bechna padta hai.
delivery.e: Long-term ke liye hamesha Delivery chuno.

validity.d: Order sirf aaj ke liye. Aaj nahi hua toh shaam ko apne aap cancel.

danger.d: Aapka tay kiya hua level — isse neeche gaya toh ruk kar sochna hai: bechna hai ya rakhna.
danger.e: LUPIN danger ₹1,960: iske neeche aaya toh Telegram alert.

pnl.d: Profit and Loss — kitna faayda ya nuksaan. Abhi bechne par jo hota, woh.

avg.d: Aapne ek share average kitne mein liya. Alag-alag din kharida toh sabka average.

stcg.d: Share bechne ke faayde pe tax. 1 saal se kam rakha = short-term (STCG), zyada = long-term (LTCG, kam tax).
stcg.e: Short-term: 1 saal se kam. Long-term: 1 saal se zyada.

gmp.d: Grey Market Premium — IPO list hone se pehle ka unofficial andaza. Guarantee nahi hai.
gmp.e: Issue ₹100, GMP ₹20 = log ~₹120 listing soch rahe hain.

green.t: Green hone ke liye % kyun zyada?
green.d: 20% gire toh wapas aane ke liye 25% chadhna padta hai, kyunki ab chhote amount pe % lagta hai.

daymove.d: Kal band hone ke price se aaj kitna upar-neeche hua.
